items.item_text: Essential Duties: • Assists the teacher in keeping the classroom and outdoor play areas clean and orderly. • Assists children in developing motor skills through supervision and participation in various activities and games: assists children with grooming and toilet activities. • Reads stories. • Prepares arts and crafts projects and assists children with them. • Takes notes regarding student performance; plans and conducts certain activities for children as assigned by the teacher; prepares bulletin boards and various displays • Assists with developmental testing; maintains books, audio devices, and other supplies for use in the classroom. • Assist with snack time by preparing the snack, setting tables, and cleaning up. Physical Ability: Constant walking and standing; pushing swings; pulling wagons, sitting on floor and in child size chairs; and lift and carry preschool age children and equipment. SPECIAL NOTE: The list of essential functions, other typical duties, and physical abilities is not exhaustive and may be supplemented as necessary in accordance with the requirements of the job.
